newsitem.title: CHINA: China's ICBC aims to reduce bad loan ratio.
newsitem.headline: China's ICBC aims to reduce bad loan ratio.

text.p: The Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, the nation's largest bank, aims to reduce its bad loan ratio by two percentage points this year, the China Daily said on Thursday.
Bank officials refused to give the current ratio of bad loans to total credits, the newspaper said.
The bank would focus on loans to large and profitable enterprises and would ignore small, inefficient firms to boost the quality of its loans, the newspaper said quoting bank president Liu Tinghuan.
The bank will also use its reserves to write off some bad loans, Liu said.
The bank extended 64.3 billion yuan more in loans in the first half, he said.
